architecturePackageMissing.reason: P0 is a shared-source monolith and has no app-owned architecture package yet.

moduleManifestsMissing.reason: The Core and UI module manifests do not exist in the P0 monolith.

projectPackageReferenceMissing.reason: project.yml cannot reference the local architecture package until that package exists.

projectProductDependenciesMissing.reason: The two hosts do not yet compose the six required app-owned products.

architectureTestTargetMissing.reason: The standalone architecture XCTest is present before project target extraction.

monolithicAppTargets.reason: Both application targets currently compile the complete shared RuneScrib source tree.

appOwnedSingletonDeclarations.reason: Eight legacy app-owned services still expose shared instances.

appOwnedSingletonReferences.reason: Legacy Core, UI, and host call sites still resolve app-owned services globally.

featureNotificationCenterCalls.reason: Three navigation and reply flows still post or subscribe through NotificationCenter.

featureNotificationNames.reason: The P0 UI declares three app-specific notification names.

notificationCenterDefaultUses.reason: P0 contains six feature-channel uses and two local media-finish observer operations.

temporaryApplicationSessionAdapters.reason: One key-free hosted-view adapter bridges the application service until the single UI module owns observation.

hostLegacyBoundaryReferences.reason: The hosts still compose shared services, post UI notifications, and invoke the legacy input router.

hostPhysicalLines.reason: The P3 production composition root temporarily coexists with the legacy app and delegate bootstrap until runtime activation becomes authoritative.
